component.name: Yoyu Companion
component.summary: Feed your Claude Code usage to a Yoyu board

description.p: Yoyu is a small ESP32 desk display that shows how much of your Claude Code usage window is left, so you can see it without breaking off what you are doing to go and check.
This is the companion that runs on your computer. It reads your usage and pushes it to the board over your network, which means the board never needs your Claude login of its own.
It sits in the system tray. There is also a headless command-line version for servers and for running under a scheduler.
